meta.title: Learn — Saede
meta.description: Open to everyone. What is actually going on underneath hair loss, what to ask your doctor to test, and honest write-ups of the options that are not us.

sections.heading: The information you have been looking for.
sections.lead: Open to everyone, whether you ever buy anything from us or not. This is the part of Saede that exists for the mission rather than the margin.

paragraphs: Our founder spent more than four years piecing this together herself, late at night, from research papers, because nobody would explain it to her. Putting it behind a paywall would make us exactly the thing we are annoyed about.

So the education is free. That includes the parts where the right answer is not a supplement — including minoxidil, which is a medicine, and which we write about because you deserve to understand your options rather than only the one we sell.
sections.statement: If what you actually need is a doctor, we would rather you found that out here.

sections.heading: Get your bloods done.
paragraphs: If you take one thing from this hub, take that one. Ask for ferritin, thyroid function and vitamin D specifically.
